verdict.rationale: Missive's developer docs list webhooks among its own developer tools, alongside the REST API and custom channels, so the product directly claims the capability. That is the only evidence: a single thin mention with no detail on how to register a webhook, which events are available, or what the payload looks like. MCP, rules and API endpoints are separate features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration (API or UI), event type catalogue, payload/signature/retry details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Missive developer tools: REST API, UI integrations, webhooks, and custom channels for full customization.
